description: The chart illustrates the number of datasets by year, categorized by the number of languages represented. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled from 2012 to 2022 in chronological order. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 10^2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a year and containing two bars corresponding to datasets with 1 language (blue) and more than 1 language (orange). The bars for 1 language are consistently taller than those for more than 1 language, except in 2022, where the bar for more than 1 language is slightly lighter and almost as tall as the bar for 1 language. The number of datasets with 1 language increases steadily from 2 in 2012 to 130 in 2021, while datasets with more than 1 language appear from 2017 onwards, reaching 30 in 2021. The bars are not sorted in any particular order other than chronological. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding.
